topic.title: Waste Planning / Waste Hierarchy / Recovery
topic.source_contract: waste stream identity, arisings and need, waste hierarchy option, site and technology, planning and environmental permits, capacity, construction, commissioning, operation, recovery performance and compliance evidence

scope_guards: Waste arisings are not treated as secured feedstock.
A position in the waste hierarchy is not automatic planning acceptability.
Planning permission is not an environmental permit.
An environmental permit is not completed construction.
Installed capacity is not actual operational throughput.
Commissioning is not stable compliant operation.
A recovery label is not treated as measured recovery performance.
No score or promotion is written without exact permission, permit, construction, throughput and compliance evidence.
